name: Anneliese Baumgartner
bio:
Anneliese discovered her passion for motorsport while attending a local rally race as a teenager. Fascinated by the roar of the engines and the precision of the drivers, she knew she wanted to be part of the racing world. After earning a degree in marketing, she began her career in the automotive industry, eventually transitioning to motorsport marketing. She worked for smaller racing teams before joining Proton by Premotion.

Anneliese is a pragmatic and results-oriented marketing coordinator. She believes in data-driven decisions and always focuses on maximizing the return on investment for every marketing campaign. Her approach is methodical, and she's known for her ability to stay calm under pressure. Anneliese stands out due to her ability to connect technical specifications with compelling narratives, making complex engineering understandable and interesting for a wider audience.
